nodes.description: owner: address of the contract owner, set from msg.sender in Owned constructor, guarded by onlyOwner.
newOwner: pending owner address used by two-step ownership transfer.
newun: address used as a transfer gate/blacklist target in transfer and transferFrom.
balances: mapping(address => uint) of token balances, written by transfer/transferFrom and the constructor.
allowed: nested mapping allowance table written by approve/approveAndCall and decremented by transferFrom.
_totalSupply: internal total token supply set in the TokenERC20 constructor.
symbol: token symbol 'SOUP'.
name: token name 'Chicken Soup Protocol'.
decimals: token decimals (18).
transfer(address to, uint tokens): public token transfer that reverts when to == newun and updates balances[msg.sender]/balances[to] with SafeMath.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves tokens using allowance; sets newun to to when from is zero address and newun is zero, otherwise reverts when to == newun.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval, an uncontrolled external call.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner, stages newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner and finalizes ownership transfer.
transfernewun(address _newun): onlyOwner, sets the newun gate address.
clearCNDAO(): onlyOwner, transfers the entire contract balance to msg.sender via a low-level transfer.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
TokenERC20 fallback function, external payable, immediately reverts so plain Ether transfers fail.
ChickenSoupProtocol fallback function, external payable with empty body that accepts Ether.
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
TokenERC20 constructor: initializes symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to owner and emits Transfer.
SafeMath.add(uint a, uint b): checked addition with overflow require.
SafeMath.sub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction with underflow require.
SafeMath.mul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication with overflow require.
SafeMath.div(uint a, uint b): checked division with zero-divisor require.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as owner, mapping key, allowance owner and Ether recipient.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, address(this), data) performed after allowance state write, enabling reentrancy.
_owner.transfer(address(this).balance): sends the whole contract balance to msg.sender with a fixed-gas external transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Owned constructor, making the caller the privileged account.
balances[msg.sender] is used as a caller-controlled mapping key for debiting tokens.
allowed[msg.sender][spender] is written/read using the caller-controlled address as the owner key.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfernewun is gated by onlyOwner, restricting execution to msg.sender == owner.
clearCNDAO is gated by onlyOwner and pays out to msg.sender.
The Ether recipient _owner is set to msg.sender, so the caller receives the contract balance.
clearCNDAO triggers the external value transfer that can hand control to the recipient.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the spender contract after writing the allowance.
Caller-supplied tokens value is passed into the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary caller-supplied calldata is forwarded to the untrusted spender contract.
The external callee can call back into token functions (approveAndCall/approve/transfer) before approveAndCall returns.
The untrusted spender contract can re-enter transferFrom using the freshly granted allowance.
The recipient contract fallback executes during the balance transfer, allowing re-entrant calls into the protocol.
transfer subtracts from balances[msg.sender] and adds to balances[to] via SafeMath.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to] using SafeMath sub/add.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] with SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom reads and conditionally assigns the newun gate address.
transfer requires to != newun, so the state variable gates the transfer destination.
transferFrom checks to != newun when newun is already set.
approve stores the allowance into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall stores the allowance before performing the external call.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
totalSupply derives its result from the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply using SafeMath.sub.
transfernewun, restricted by onlyOwner, writes the newun gate address.
TokenERC20 constructor mints the whole supply into balances[owner].
TokenERC20 constructor sets the _totalSupply value.
TokenERC20 constructor credits the initial supply to the owner address.
transferOwnership, guarded by onlyOwner, writes the pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears the pending newOwner to address(0).
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable after the msg.sender check.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter 'to' of transfer only exists to select the destination balance entry of transfer.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer is the amount consumed by transfer balance arithmetic.
Parameter 'spender' of approve is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve is only used as the allowance value written by approve.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom is only used to index balances/allowed inside transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom only selects the credited balance inside transferFrom.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom is the amount moved by transferFrom SafeMath operations.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall is the target of the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall is forwarded directly into the unsafe external receiveApproval call.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall is forwarded directly into the unsafe external receiveApproval call.
Parameter '_newOwner' of transferOwnership is only assigned to the newOwner state variable.
Parameter '_newun' of transfernewun is only assigned to the newun state variable.
Local _owner in clearCNDAO is just msg.sender and is the target of the balance transfer.
Local result 'c' in SafeMath.add only holds the checked addition result of that function.
